copy.tagline: 运用精灵、瓦片地图与物理系统构建 2D 游戏
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你刚开始做 2D 游戏，想弄清楚精灵、地图和物理怎么用
copy.tagline_en: Build 2D games using sprites, tilemaps, physics and camera
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're just starting 2D games and need to understand sprites, tilemaps and physics.

howto.what: 当 Claude 处理 2D 游戏开发相关任务时，会应用 2D 游戏开发原则：包括精灵图集、瓦片地图、物理碰撞、相机系统等；并建议避免常见反模式，如使用图集而非独立纹理、简化碰撞体、平滑相机跟随等。
howto.when: 当用户请求设计或实现 2D 游戏，或提及精灵图、瓦片地图、2D 物理等元素时触发。

say.text: 如何组织2D游戏的精灵图集？
say.note: Claude会给出图集使用和减少绘制调用的建议。

say.text: 我的2D平台跳跃手感不好，怎么调？
say.note: Claude会介绍土狼时间、跳跃缓冲等模式。

say.text: 2D游戏相机怎么跟随角色才自然？
say.note: Claude会说明平滑跟随与震屏控制。

howto.what_en: When handling 2D game development tasks, Claude applies 2D game principles: sprite atlases, tilemap design, simplified collision shapes, fixed timestep, smooth camera following, and avoids common anti-patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to design or build a 2D game, or mentions sprites, tilemaps, 2D physics, etc.

say_en.text: How should I organize sprite atlases for a 2D game?
say_en.note: Claude suggests atlas usage and draw call reduction.

say_en.text: My 2D platformer jump feels off. How can I fix it?
say_en.note: Claude covers coyote time and jump buffering.

say_en.text: How do I make the camera follow the character naturally?
say_en.note: Claude explains smooth follow and screen shake control.
